name: Fleur du Mal

prices.note: All 114 items in the dresses collection are regular price (no compare_at above price). Low: Le Stretch Lace Slip Dress $98; top: Leather Heart Dress and Leather Overall Dress $998. Median $448. Juliet Button Slip (100% silk georgette body) $328–$348.

notes: About: 'a luxury lingerie, fashion & sexual wellness brand founded by Jennifer Zuccarini'; 'the go-to brand for slip dresses, bodysuits, and lingerie-inspired styles'; founder has led it 'since 2012'.
meta.json: shop address New York, US; currency USD; ships_to includes '*', US, CA, GB, AU. Homepage meta: 'Free U.S. shipping on orders $195+'.
Boutiques page: Nolita (372 Broome Street, New York), Upper East Side, Williamsburg and Los Angeles boutiques, so us_stores true.

Refund policy: returns of unworn items within 30 days of the order shipping; full price for exchange, credit or refund; $10 fee on US returns for refund (credit and exchange free, prepaid UPS label); international returns $20 flat.
Size options across the dresses collection: XS, S, M, L, XL, plus numeric 0–10 on some styles and DD-cup variants; no plus range.
Juliet Button Slip: 'made from lightweight silk georgette with lace appliqué detailing', body 100% silk. Le Stretch Lace Slip Dress: nylon/spandex lace with silk straps.
